map.根据溶解度随温度变化预测冷却结晶收率，优化结晶工艺: Predicts cooling crystallization yield from how solubility varies with temperature to optimize the crystallization process
map.核心计算公式（按输入变量）：max(0, actualDissolved - r: Core formulas (from the input variables): max(0, actualDissolved - remainLow); theoreticalCrystal x (1 - lossRate/100); (actualCrystal / feed) x 100
map.高温溶解度 (g/100mL溶剂): Solubility at high temperature (g/100 mL solvent)
map.低温溶解度 (g/100mL溶剂): Solubility at low temperature (g/100 mL solvent)
map.黄芩苷：水-乙醇体系，高温70°C溶解，低温5°C结晶: Baicalin: water-ethanol system, dissolves at 70 C and crystallizes at 5 C
map.小檗碱：甲醇-水体系，热溶冷析: Berberine: methanol-water system, dissolve hot and crystallize on cooling
map.芦丁：沸水溶解，冷却结晶: Rutin: dissolved in boiling water, crystallizes on cooling
map.青蒿素：石油醚-乙酸乙酯体系，低温结晶: Artemisinin: petroleum ether-ethyl acetate system, crystallizes at low temperature
map.投料 100 g、高温溶解度 20%、低温 2%、溶剂 1000 mL、损失 5: Charge 100 g, high-temperature solubility 20%, low-temperature 2%, solvent 1000 mL, loss 5%: solubility limit = 20x1000/100 = 200 g, actual dissolved 100 g, low-temperature remainder = 2x1000/100 = 20 g, theoretical crystal = 80 g, actual crystal = 80x0.95 = 76 g, yield 76%.
map.低温溶解度降到 1% → 残留 10 g，理论晶 90 g，收率升至约 85.5: Lowering the low-temperature solubility to 1% leaves 10 g, theoretical crystal 90 g, and the yield rises to about 85.5%.
map.靠加入反溶剂降低溶解度，逻辑同溶解度差乘溶剂总量。: It lowers solubility by adding an antisolvent, following the same logic of solubility difference multiplied by total solvent volume.
map.收率为何低于理论？: Why is the yield below theory?
map.母液夹带、器壁吸附、过滤损失，以 lossRate 折算。: Mother liquor entrainment, adsorption on the vessel wall and filtration losses, converted as lossRate.

map.高温可溶量 = 高温溶解度(g/100mL) × 溶剂体积(mL) ÷ 100: Hot soluble amount = hot solubility (g/100mL) × solvent volume (mL) ÷ 100
map.实际溶解量 = min(投料量, 高温可溶量)；未溶量 = 投料量 − 实际溶解: Actual dissolved amount = min(feed amount, hot soluble amount); undissolved amount = feed amount − actual dissolved amount
map.低温残留量 = 低温溶解度 × 溶剂体积 ÷ 100: Low-temperature residual amount = low-temperature solubility × solvent volume ÷ 100
map.实际结晶量 = 理论结晶量 × (1 − 结晶损失率 ÷ 100): Actual crystallized amount = theoretical crystallized amount × (1 − crystallization loss rate ÷ 100)
map.结晶收率 = 实际结晶量 ÷ 投料量 × 100%: Crystallization yield = actual crystallized amount ÷ feed amount × 100%
map.纯度提升倍数 = 高温溶解度 ÷ 低温溶解度（理想 ≥5:1）: Purity improvement factor = hot solubility ÷ low-temperature solubility (ideally ≥ 5:1)
map.过饱和度 = 实际溶解量 ÷ 低温残留量（>5 易生细晶或油析）: Supersaturation = actual dissolved amount ÷ low-temperature residual amount (> 5 tends to produce fine crystals or oiling out)
map.理论结晶量 = max(0, 实际溶解量 − 低温残留量): Theoretical crystallized amount = max(0, actual dissolved amount − low-temperature residual amount)
